brief.zh: 质检台上，「标准件」是合格零件的照片，「实物」是传送带上这一件。实物上的凹坑比标准件暗。凹坑处输出 1，其余输出 0。
brief.en: At the inspection station, the "Reference" is a photo of a good part and the "Part" is the one on the belt. Dents on the part are darker than the reference. Output 1 on the dents and 0 everywhere else.

hint.zh: 零件本身有亮有暗，单看实物分不出哪里是凹坑。
hint.en: The part itself has light and dark areas, so the part alone cannot tell you where the dents are.

after.zh: 和标准件逐格比，零件本来的明暗就抵消了，只剩下缺陷。
after.en: Compared cell by cell with the reference, the part's own light and dark cancel out and only the defects are left.

t.zh: 工厂的流水线上，相机给每个零件拍一张照，和合格零件的照片比一比，挑出有缺陷的。这一章最后三关，就在这样一台质检台上。
t.en: On a factory line, a camera photographs every part and compares it with a photo of a good one, picking out the faulty ones. The last three levels of this chapter take place at such an inspection station.

t.zh: 两个输入：「标准件」是合格零件的照片，「实物」是传送带上这一件，位置已经对齐。零件本身就有亮有暗。
t.en: Two inputs: the "Reference" is a photo of a good part, and the "Part" is the one on the belt, already lined up. The part itself has light and dark areas.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：实物上的凹坑比标准件暗，在凹坑处输出 1，其余输出 0。
t.en: Your task in this level: dents on the part are darker than on the reference. Output 1 on the dents and 0 everywhere else.
